PlantX v3.8.0 delivers enterprise workflow orchestration for PlantLogistic together with a platform-wide UI, localization, validation, and authorization hardening pass.

## Highlights

- Visual, versioned business workflow designer with draft, publish, archive, restore, and default-workflow management.
- Configurable steps, action-aware transitions, user/organization-unit assignments, active tasks, and event timelines.
- Workflow-driven plan sheets with line review, forecast validation, rejection feedback, and automatic order generation.
- Optimistic logistics board moves with graph-aware routing, ownership controls, revision safety, and audited administrator overrides.
- Tenant-scoped Prisma workflow models, production migration, seed bootstrap, and existing plan-sheet backfill.
- Broader Turkish/English localization and consistent shadcn/ui-based dialogs, forms, tables, loading states, and semantic theme tokens.

## Bug fixes and security

- Closed company-scoping gaps in vehicle model and plan-sheet mutations.
- Prevented unauthorized or stale workflow and vehicle transitions through server-side task ownership and revision guards.
- Blocked missing/past forecast dates, invalid review states, locked-row edits, and empty rejection reasons.
- Replaced native browser confirmations and hardcoded UI strings with accessible localized application primitives.
- Added validation coverage for workflow topology, assignments, runtime permissions, and plan-sheet business rules.
- Updated Next.js, Auth.js, Nodemailer, Prisma, and PDF dependencies to current patched release lines.
- Bundled Geist locally and made Auth/Nodemailer workspace resolution deterministic for network-independent production and desktop builds.

## Upgrade notes

1. Apply `packages/db/prisma/migrations/20260830230000_add_logistic_workflow_engine/migration.sql` with `prisma migrate deploy`.
2. Regenerate the Prisma client with `npm run db:generate`.
3. Rebuild the application with `docker-compose up -d --build app`.
4. Rebuild desktop bundles with `npm run desktop:build` when distributing the Electron application.

See [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/aokcuoglu/plantx/blob/v3.8.0/CHANGELOG.md) for the complete Added / Changed / Fixed / Security record.
